headline: Kodak really acted like the cop wasn’t even there During the packed 2016 show in Pompano B
body: Kodak really acted like the cop wasn’t even there During the packed 2016 show in Pompano Beach, a police officer walked onto the stage to shut things down because of the crowd, but Kodak just kept performing like nothing had happened. The officer was standing right there trying to get his attention, while Kodak kept walking around the stage, smiling and rapping to the crowd. He didn’t stop, didn’t argue, and barely even acknowledged her being there.

source_caption_text:
Kodak really acted like the cop wasn’t even there 😭😭💀

During the packed 2016 show in Pompano Beach, a police officer walked onto the stage to shut things down because of the crowd, but Kodak just kept performing like nothing had happened.

The officer was standing right there trying to get his attention, while Kodak kept walking around the stage, smiling and rapping to the crowd. He didn’t stop, didn’t argue, and barely even acknowledged her being there.

The whole thing got even crazier because the crowd was going wild while this was happening. Kodak just kept doing his thing until the moment became one of those clips people still bring up whenever they talk about his early career.

#kodakblack #hiphop #concerts
